gloss: salted dried fish; salt-preserved dried seafood

definitions.gloss: salted dried fish; salt-preserved dried seafood
definitions.explanation: Seafood that has been preserved by salting and then drying. A traditional Japanese food preservation method that produces ingredients with concentrated flavor, commonly used in everyday cooking.

examples.japanese: {塩干物|しおひもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I grill salted dried fish and eat it.

examples.english: In Japan's coastal areas, salted dried seafood has long been valued as a preserved food.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt), {干|ひ} (dried), and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). A category of preserved seafood products that includes items like ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧ (dried fish) that have been additionally salted. Common examples include salted and dried horse mackerel, sardines, and squid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩干物|しおひもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill salted dried fish

- {塩干物|しおひもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: processing of salted dried seafood

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: dried fish — may or may not be salted; the broader category
- {塩鮭|しおざけ}: salted salmon — a specific type of salted fish
- ⟦{燻製|くんせい}→燻製：13478_kunsei⟧: smoked food — preserved by smoking rather than salt-drying
